tasks.description: Name verification.md in every governance list in rebase-project.md; name framework rules (async-discipline.md, autonomy.md, command-status.md) explicitly instead of by example, etc., or every-.md-file wording; add BATS tests to scaffold-project.test.sh. Dependencies: none. Serves O1.

Add --agent-status and --sync-agents modes to scaffold-project.sh (lift inline Python into a function; route new modes before scaffold_project; send info() output to stderr in these modes; compare with end-of-file whitespace removed). Add a Path Resolution row to rebase-project.md and point section 2.1 step 3 and section 4.1 at the script. Add BATS tests. Dependencies: none. Serves O2, O3.

requirements.statement: Nothing in /rebase-project's text can be read as permitting it to replace .claude/rules/verification.md: every list of governance files names it, and framework rules are named explicitly rather than as every file in the template rules directory.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, O1 (must pass: yes)

requirements.statement: /rebase-project reports an agent as updated only when the plugin's agent differs from the project's copy in something other than the generated skill content (the skills: frontmatter list and the ENSEMBLE:SKILLS marked section).
requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, O2 (must pass: yes)

requirements.statement: The agent comparison is made by a deterministic script, not by the model reading two files.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, O3 (must pass: not marked)
